question: What would come in (2)
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**' i.e. **collapse**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the importance of balancing freedom with responsibility.
 
• The blank (2) refers to a negative consequence that arises if freedom lacks responsibility.
 
• The word "**collapse**" fits contextually as it signifies moral and civic breakdown that may occur when boundaries and shared responsibility are ignored.
 
• Other options like "revival," "education," and "loyalty" do not indicate a negative consequence and hence do not fit here.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**collapse**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Revival** (पुनरुद्धार): Means improvement or renewal, which contradicts the context of a negative outcome.
 
• **Education** (शिक्षा): Means learning or instruction, unrelated to the moral or civic consequence described.
 
• **Loyalty** (निष्ठा): Refers to faithfulness or allegiance, which does not indicate collapse or breakdown.
